_help: Wording for doc/controls.html. Keys are [init.]gamepad<N>.<control>; see tools/control_layout.py. '*' applies to every OpMode. Rebuild or run: python3 tools/control_layout.py

TeleOp.gamepad1.left_stick: Drive (field-centric: forward = away from our driver station)
TeleOp.gamepad1.right_stick: Point the intake this way (field-centric); holds that heading when let go
TeleOp.gamepad1.right_trigger: Hold: open gate and feed the shooter
TeleOp.gamepad2.square: Tap: hive LEFT cell is up. Hold 1 s: also lock / unlock auto hive
TeleOp.gamepad2.circle: Tap: hive RIGHT cell is up. Hold 1 s: also lock / unlock auto hive
TeleOp.gamepad2.share: Reset pose: pushed into our LEFT corner, back to alliance wall
TeleOp.gamepad2.options: Reset pose: pushed into our RIGHT corner, back to alliance wall
TeleOp.init.gamepad2.share: Start pose: pushed into our LEFT corner, back to alliance wall
TeleOp.init.gamepad2.options: Start pose: pushed into our RIGHT corner, back to alliance wall

Heading Tuner.gamepad1.left_stick: Drive (forward = the way the robot faced at start)
Heading Tuner.gamepad1.right_stick: Point the robot this way; holds that heading when let go
Heading Tuner.gamepad1.square: Jump target heading left by stepDegrees
Heading Tuner.gamepad1.cross: Jump target heading to the start heading
Heading Tuner.gamepad1.circle: Jump target heading right by stepDegrees

Motor Tester.gamepad1.right_bumper: Motor: hold to spin forward. Servo: move + step
Motor Tester.gamepad1.left_bumper: Motor: hold to spin reverse. Servo: move - step
Motor Tester.gamepad1.dpad_up: Motor: more power. Servo: bigger step
Motor Tester.gamepad1.dpad_down: Motor: less power. Servo: smaller step
